notes: Districts on this leaf: Mahbubnagar (cols 26-28), Nalgonda (29-31), Aurangabad (32-34), Bir (35-37), Nander (38-40); table continues from leaf 231 and onto leaf 233. Printed arithmetic shows Dravidian Family (under (a)) = Andhra group + Dravida group + Intermediate group, so Intermediate group/Gondi are placed under Dravidian Family in lang_path. Italic persons figures print 4 with a very thin crossbar so it can look like 1; each such reading was confirmed by M+F and group sums (e.g. Mahbubnagar Dravidian 848,685; Nalgonda Dravidian 1,034,374, Dravida 4,868, Rajasthani 543; Aurangabad Dravida 6,445, Marathi 740,614; Bir Lambadi 5,254, Marathi 552,642, Rajasthani 4,763; Nander IE 544,567, Marathi 450,621). Print inconsistencies kept as printed: (1) Nalgonda TOTAL persons printed 1,113,409, but M+F = 1,133,409 and A+B+C = 1,133,409. (2) Nalgonda Western Hindi (b) persons printed 1,317, but M+F = 697+649 = 1,346 and the Indo-Aryan (b) total 1,899 requires 1,346. (3) Bir Dravidian Family males printed 4,190, but Andhra+Dravida+Intermediate males = 2,437+1,999+54 = 4,490 and (a) - IE = 318,732-314,242 = 4,490; persons 7,486 and females 2,996 are consistent with 4,490.
